newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Ausdrill bids on W. Africa contracts.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Ausdrill bids on W. Africa contracts.

text.p: Mining services company Ausdrill Ltd said on Friday it is bidding with partner Eltin Ltd for two mining contracts in west Africa, worth a total of about A$225 million.
Ausdrill managing director Ron Sayers said the contracts were at Ashanti Goldfields Co Ltd's Bibiani project in Ghana and Siguiri project in Guinea.
The Bibiani contract was worth about A$150 million and the Siguri project about half that, he said.
Ausdrill and Eltin formed a joint venture last year to bid for contracts in West Africa.
Sayers said Ausdrill believed its operations in Ghana were too small to handle the six or seven major mining contacts it expected to be let in the next two or three years.

"By forming a joint venture with Eltin we have bid all jobs. We have won the first two and we believe we have a distinct possibility of winning more over the next few years," he told a Securities Institute of Australia briefing.
The joint venture was awarded a A$135 million contract on the Tarkwa gold project in Ghana last November and a A$154 million contact for surface mining at the Damang project in February.
Sayers, who will step down as managing director on May 2, declined to name other potential projects, but said he believed others were likely to come up in the next 12-18 months.
Sayers is to be replaced by director Ray Taylor.
